name: Maya Elbeth
source:
A new priest of the Cleanup Department of the Saint Sheol temple who just reached adulthood.

She dies in an unfortunate accident and is then ressurected as a "dead girl assistant"! Her new mission is to bake handmade pies and defeat the men of the temple by revealing their secrets through the power of the "Short Almond Cinnamon Vanilla Caramel Extra Strawberry Java Chip Whipped Chocolate Syrup Cream Pie".
